headline: Crypto Market Structure Brief - 11 November 2026
summary: Ethereum leads chains by TVL at $40.95bn, followed by Base at $5.76bn and Solana at $5.06bn. Uniswap V3 recorded the highest DEX volume at $1.19bn over 24h while Tether generated the top fees at $16.77m. USDT circulation stands at $175.72bn and USDC at $70.11bn, with several stablecoins showing peg deviations. Base holds the largest L2 TVS at $13.78bn amid multiple recent security incidents.
